title: ALLSELECTED of a column, with no iteration active, returns every value: a filter on another column doesn't narrow it

source.quote: As a result, all the product names are returned because neither Color nor Brand filter the Product[Product] column
source.supports: the article runs this query shape (CALCULATETABLE over ROW with CONCATENATEX over ALLSELECTED of a column, filtered on other columns) and shows that every product comes back

source.quote: ALLSELECTED does not take into account the filter context

derivation: There is no iterator around ALLSELECTED, so no shadow filter context exists. The filter Color = Red is on another column, so it only cross-filters Product[Product], which ALLSELECTED ignores. All four products are returned: Bike, Helmet, Lock, Scooter, concatenated in ascending order.
